agenda_place: Council Chambers, Municipal Hall, 37955 Second Avenue
preview: This short special meeting exists only so council can move into a closed session (a private meeting the public cannot attend) to receive legal advice from its lawyers. There is nothing for residents to watch after the opening.

agenda_items.plain: Council will vote to close the meeting to the public so it can receive legal advice that is protected by solicitor and client privilege (the rule that keeps talks between a client and their lawyer private).
